prototype_disclaimer: Experimental research prototype only. It does not replace Avalanche Canada guidance or field assessment. Model scores are relative indices, not probabilities.

supersedes.reason: Adds explicit metric formulas and false-negative area without relaxing the frozen eligibility, independence, anti-leakage, or cohort rules.

evaluation_scope.release_state_rule: Observed release geometry, thickness normal to slope, density, and their uncertainty and hashes must be frozen independently before the runout target is opened.
evaluation_scope.calibration_holdout_rule: Calibration and final holdout are separate. No path_group_id or storm_group_id may cross partitions; mountain groups remain together when event independence cannot be justified.

runout_distance_error.uncertainty_reporting: Report the observed endpoint horizontal uncertainty in metres beside every event error and at cohort level.

observed_area_overlap.intersection_over_union: intersection_cell_count / union_cell_count on the common valid evaluation mask

false_positive_area_m2.formula: count(predicted_positive and observed_negative and valid) * abs(pixel_width_m * pixel_height_m)
false_positive_area_m2.required_evidence: A surveyed complete-search/detection mask; unknown or unmapped cells are excluded, never treated as observed negatives.

false_negative_area_m2.formula: count(observed_positive and predicted_negative and valid) * abs(pixel_width_m * pixel_height_m)
false_negative_area_m2.required_evidence: An independently observed dense-flow target polygon and valid mapped-coverage mask.

depth_velocity_pressure.activation_rule: Add field-specific metrics and tolerances before any model run only after independent observations include quantity semantics, units, CRS/grid, masks, measurement method, time support, uncertainty, and component attribution.

cohort_summary.aggregation: event-level values plus median, interquartile range, and bootstrap confidence interval

licence_findings.RegObs: NLOD 2.0 metadata/API records were accessible, but the audited records did not contain the full independent release-state, event-surface terrain, component target, coverage, and uncertainty package.
licence_findings.EnviDat_1999_outlines: CC BY-SA 4.0; previously viewed/development-only and lacks the full independently observed release-state and complete-search package required by this protocol.
licence_findings.other_authoritative_sources: The source audit records provenance and access conditions. No source supplied a contract-complete, untouched final-holdout cohort.

missing_for_all_26_strict_candidates: independent human review and independently reviewed release geometry
normal-to-slope release thickness and transferable release density evidence
frozen path, mountain, storm, projected CRS, and coordinate-transform identities
release mapping method, uncertainty, and confidence
resolved pixel-validity and survey coverage/detection masks
reviewed terminal dense-flow deposit polygon or terminal toe
data_blocker.reason: Running or calibrating against incomplete targets would invent inputs, convert unknown coverage into negatives, or leak holdout information.

single_next_requirement_before_field_val: Acquire and independently code-review one licence-compatible, untouched cohort of at least 12 dry dense-slab events spanning at least 6 independent paths, 2 mountains, and 3 storm cycles, then freeze calibration/holdout groups before predictions; for every event preserve original bytes and hashes, licence, UTC interval, event-surface DEM with projected-metre CRS and datum lineage, an independently observed release polygon with normal-to-slope thickness and density uncertainty, a component-attributed terminal dense-flow deposit polygon or endpoint with positional uncertainty, and an explicit surveyed coverage/detection mask that distinguishes observed negatives from unknown cells.
